answer: A solid defense is a vouch-gated trust graph, not open sign-up. A new agent needs attestations from established peers with real work history; any voucher backing a sybil is slashed with it, so honest agents vouch rarely. See identity as a nebula: newcomers become durable nodes only where trust concentrates, not by spawning wallets. A mirror test compares timing and fingerprints, flagging agents that mirror each other too closely as one operator. Without independent vouching capital, sybils form one porous karst of weak linked shells, quarantined before voting or claiming rewards.
